accounting: Each API stage is assigned exactly once by exclusive time. Frontend roots are independent. Original frozen implementation maps are unchanged; this supplement includes all emitted wrappers.

stages.description: WindowedDisplacementMap::forward, including damping/window and FFT transform.
Full1D::SEM construction from the loaded Earth model and source, including mesh and system matrix/preconditioner setup performed by the constructor.
Actual CBLAS ZGEMM; records one complex matrix product dimension triplet and contributes m*n*k to tensor_actual_gemm_macs.
Exact-key lookup, signatures, and response cache miss computation; records cache hit/miss and input RHS widths.
Exact unit-basis QR reconstruction of requested weighted RHS and response mixing.

Caller API duration including candidate function return/local cleanup. Its exclusive remainder is candidate work not placed in narrower scopes: allocations, input/key/map bookkeeping, value copies and moves, per-bin bookkeeping, and destruction. Profile serialization itself is outside this scope and included in candidate_call_wall_s.
Exclusive api misc cleanup cost at the candidate_body scope; inclusive time also contains nested named scopes and is not additive.
FixedMeshAdjointSolver::systemMatrix for current complex frequency and family.
Final weighted spectrum inner product and scalar objective.
Exact-key cross-objective forward tensor field cache lookup; hit/miss counters are candidate-root scoped.
Retained forward volume strain and receiver displacement insertion on miss.
EquilibratedSparseLU forward solve, including RHS/result diagonal scaling.
Per-bin workspace creation outside the modal loops; includes modal projection, source treatment/lift, receiver map preparation, and block capture.
Exclusive source receiver recovery cost at the frequency_workspace_prepare_and_modal_capture scope; inclusive time also contains nested named scopes and is not additive.
Full receiver-weighted Hermitian-adjoint solve when the non-batch branch is used.
InputParametersNew construction, model/input parser, source/event metadata and frequency setup.
WindowedDisplacementMap::adjoint(weightsSI), P* construction.
Rank-minimal receiver basis Hermitian-adjoint solve on the shared-factor non-batch route.
Radial, spheroidal and toroidal modal families; source/lift coefficients, receiver projection, and solver calls. This is a family-level scope, not per-point arithmetic.
Exclusive angular plan basis cost at the packed_Wigner_d_table_build scope; inclusive time also contains nested named scopes and is not additive.
Exclusive angular plan basis cost at the packed_angular_coefficients_and_basis_build scope; inclusive time also contains nested named scopes and is not additive.
Writes the temporary parameter file consumed by InputParametersNew.
Existing pointKernel formula and aggregate point-kernel scatter over the complete volume batch.
Enclosing pole-frame coefficient sampling for the volume and receiver grid.
Radial coefficient construction using existing interpolation plans and r-strain numerators; one scope per existing coefficient-build batch.
Radial-only modal sampling, including the l=0 branch.
The existing radial degree-zero source and adjoint path.
Exact rank-minimal receiver row selection, QR solves, reconstruction matrix; records input and selected basis dimensions.
Exclusive representative receiver sampling cost at the receiver_frame_geometry_phase_spin_rotation_and_scatter scope; inclusive time also contains nested named scopes and is not additive.
Receiver displacement suffix extraction and raw spectrum bin write.
Opens candidate/reference/coordinate streams and writes the coordinate binary before solving.
Reads the requested sample CSV into the working point grid.
Inclusive total of driver setup before candidate roots. Exclusive remainder is argument validation, path/environment checks, and setup control/bookkeeping not called out separately.
One family/degree/frequency solve path; counts degree and forward, weighted-adjoint, and unit-basis RHS widths.
Exclusive factor overhead cost at the solver_factorization_dispatch scope; inclusive time also contains nested named scopes and is not additive.
Existing sourceShellContact evaluation measured separately from volume point kernels.
Exclusive representative receiver sampling cost at the source_frame_geometry_phase_spin_rotation_and_scatter scope; inclusive time also contains nested named scopes and is not additive.
Exclusive adjoint substitution cost at the sparse_adjoint_solve_including_rhs_scaling scope; inclusive time also contains nested named scopes and is not additive.
Copied EquilibratedSparseLU row scaling and D H D matrix construction.
Copied EquilibratedSparseLU::compute; wrapper total, with exact Eigen SparseLU analyzePattern then factorize call order retained.
Exclusive forward substitution cost at the sparse_forward_solve_including_rhs_scaling scope; inclusive time also contains nested named scopes and is not additive.
Eigen SparseLU factorize on that same equilibrated matrix.
Eigen SparseLU analyzePattern on the equilibrated matrix.
Exclusive source receiver recovery cost at the spheroidal_source_lift_projection_and_solver scope; inclusive time also contains nested named scopes and is not additive.
Configures optional packet stream and initializes response, sampling-plan and forward-field cache objects before candidate roots.
Complex-basis synthesis wrapper; dimensions and batch count are reported separately from actual ZGEMM.
Builds the frame/grid angular-plan key and looks up the cached plan.
Per-component tensor radial coefficient packing and ordered (m,l) key handling.
On angular-plan miss, computes tangent frame rotations and constructs/populates the Wigner table and plan.
Looks up the direct-constructed complex-basis key in the current angular plan basis map.
On complex-basis miss, allocates/fills the angular matrix and optionally admits it to the basis cache.
Directly constructs and fills the semantic complex-basis key vector through a return-value lambda; preserves original vector construction while timing key formation.
Copies cached forward volume strain and receiver displacement into the current result when the exact forward cache hits.
On grid-cache miss, validates and constructs radial-trace, shared-angle, and point maps, then admits or retains the layout.
Builds the exact semantic volume-grid key and performs its cache lookup; excludes cold layout construction.
Tensor sampling call including exact grid address plan creation/reuse and sample reconstruction.
Tensor field azimuthal phase, spin frame rotation and scatter to requested grid points.
Adds the reserved radial degree-zero forward/adjoint strain record to each volume result.
Samples receiver points through the existing packed route and copies radial/fluid tags and forward displacement into the receiver suffix.
Builds representative points, samples pole frames and captures coefficient records through the existing visitor.
Allocates the result vector and tags volume points with radial element and fluid metadata.
Tensor contraction route; nested scopes and counters separate plan, basis, packing, GEMM and scatter work.
